subject: Partner-led discovery — schedule technical deep dive
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Anita Rao <anita.rao@cloudbridge.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@gsi-partners.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Partner-led discovery — schedule technical deep dive

Hi Anita / Samir,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation and lots of alignment on where Redwood could help CloudBridge accelerate the marketplace integration and joint GTM. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: you’re evaluating a marketplace listing + co-managed integration to offload inference ops for customer pilots. Primary constraints: SLA for peak loads, private deployment option for regulated customers, and straightforward DevX for your integrations team.
- Redwood ask: schedule a technical deep dive/demo (60–75m) with your integration engineers and our Serving + Platform leads to walk through architecture, deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private), and a preliminary MAP for a pilot.

Proposed times (PT):
- Mon May 24 — 10:00 AM PT (preferred)
- Tue May 25 — 2:00 PM PT
- Wed May 26 — 11:00 AM PT

Agenda I’m proposing: 1) 10m intro & goals, 2) 30–35m platform demo + deployment patterns, 3) 20–30m open technical Q&A and next steps (roles / owners / MAP).

I’ve attached a short partner overview deck and architecture diagram for context. Please let me know which slot works and who on your side should join (integration lead, security contact, etc.). Mateo and Lauren will join from our side — Mateo will lead the infra/serving discussion and Lauren will cover partner enablement and marketplace requirements.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this on calendar.

Best,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Partner Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- Redwood-Partner-Overview.pdf (PDF)
- redwood-architecture-diagram.png (PNG)
From: Anita Rao <anita.rao@cloudbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@gsi-partners.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner-led discovery — schedule technical deep dive

Thanks Marissa — great recap and appreciate the clarity on agenda. 24th at 10:00 AM PT should work for our integration lead (Asha), and Samir will join for the GSI perspective. We’d like to include our security architect as well for a few minutes on private deployment constraints.

A couple of asks before the call:
- Can you share a short list of the technical attendees from Redwood (names + roles)?
- Any specific pre-reads you want the team to review besides the deck you attached?

Proposed confirmed slot: Mon May 24, 10:00 AM PT. If you can send a calendar invite and a short agenda we’ll lock it in.

Thanks,
Anita Rao
Head of Partnerships — CloudBridge
anita.rao@cloudbridge.com
